Market today: The market mood is cautious, driven by surging inflation and fears the Fed will resume rate hikes. This directly pressures your tech and chip names, as higher rates make future earnings less valuable and increase borrowing costs, amplifying risk on margin.

Your holdings: Your leveraged positions, SOXL (-53.57%), SPAL (-40.12%), MUU (-24.54%), SMCI (-19.42%), and METU (-16.26%), are all significantly underwater and below their stops. Margin amplifies these drops, making these positions particularly painful and risky.

Watch: Keep a close eye on inflation data and any Fed commentary. Also, watch for further signs of AI disruption fears spreading beyond ServiceNow.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply negative, leveraged positions; the macro environment is not forgiving.
plays: Exit SOXL, SPAL, MUU, SMCI, and METU. These leveraged positions are deeply negative, below stops, and decaying, posing extreme risk.
Trim QQQ and SMH as indicated by your scanner. This reduces overall tech concentration and takes some small profit on QQQ.
No new buys today. The current macro environment and significant losses in existing holdings suggest caution over initiating new positions.
